title: Road Hazard Line on Replacement Tire Tickets — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Road Hazard Protection line on a credit replacement ticket — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** A road hazard line is added to the balance of the one-tire replacement ticket written for an adjusted tire, because a certificate covers the whole set and a tire added to a covered set is added to its certificate.

| Road Hazard Protection certificate on the set | Road hazard line added |
|---|---|
| active, its plan does not carry its remaining term to replacement tires, and more than half of its plan term in months left | the plan's price for one tire |
| active, its plan does not carry its remaining term to replacement tires, and half or less of its term left | half of that price |
| any other set (no active certificate, or a plan that carries its remaining term to replacement tires) | nothing |

The plan's price for one tire is the plan's price percentage of the selling price recorded on the set's latest treadwear adjustment, kept between the plan's minimum and maximum price per tire. The term left is the whole calendar months from today to the certificate's expiration date, compared with half of the plan's term in months.

**Cases (hypothetical plan with a 20-month term, a 10% price percentage, a $10.00 minimum and a $30.00 maximum; recorded price $120.00):** 12 months left — 10% of $120.00 is $12.00; 8 months left — $6.00; with a recorded price of $400.00 and 12 months left, $40.00 is kept to $30.00.
